column3: “You have made your word great above all your name” is rendered “according to all Your name.” The meaning of the Hebrew is uncertain.
Close to the Hebrew; “If they have heard” is rendered “When they have heard.”
Close to the Hebrew; “Sing in the ways” is rendered “sing of the ways.”
Close to the Hebrew; NASB adds “though … Yet” to link the clauses.
Close to the Hebrew; “He will complete for me” is rendered “will accomplish what concerns me.”
